name: Audio generation
blurb: Voiceovers, music, sound effects, podcasts, dubbing and transcripts with AI, mixed to a real loudness target.
searches: new text-to-speech model release expressive voices
AI music generation model release lyrics vocals
agent skill audio generation voiceover Claude

tests.prompt: Write and produce a 30-second voiceover for a product video about a budgeting app called Penny, with a music bed underneath. Give the script, the delivery direction, the TTS settings and the ffmpeg commands to mix and export it.
tests.good: Script of about 70-80 words written for the ear; labeled delivery spec without contradictions; named engine, voice and settings; music bed kept 18-24 dB under the voice or carved/sidechain-ducked; fades; loudness normalized to about -16 or -14 LUFS with -1 dBTP; checks for pronunciation of 'Penny' and duration.

tests.prompt: Generate a 60-second upbeat instrumental for a SaaS launch video and a 3-second sonic logo that matches it. Write the prompts for a music model.
tests.good: Sentence-style prompts with mood, BPM (about 120-130), key, 2-3 named instruments and a dynamic arc; no artist names; instrumental specified; the logo shares key, instruments and style with the bed; advice to generate several takes and trim to a clean musical entrance with fades.

tests.prompt: I have a 2-hour interview recorded as four 30-minute WAV files from a body mic. Get me a speaker-labeled transcript and English subtitles.
tests.good: Merge the segments in order before ASR (not transcribe separately), convert to 16 kHz mono; pick a diarizing route with keyterms; verify length plausibility, ending, speaker count and repetition loops; subtitle cues with max 2 lines, about 42 characters per line and reading-speed limits built from word timestamps.
